name: negation_scope
description: Resolve whether an explicitly negated property holds; matched control asks which entity was named in the same sentence.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
names=['Alice','Bob','Clara','David','Emma','Felix','Grace','Henry']
props=['awake','ready','hungry','tired','calm','busy','happy','cold']
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.choice(names); p=random.choice(props); neg=random.choice([True,False]); phrase=('not ' if neg else '')+p
 text=f'Statement: {n} is {phrase}. '
 items.append({'prompt':text+f'Is {n} {p}? Answer yes or no:','answer':' '+('no' if neg else 'yes')})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'Who is mentioned? Answer with the name:','answer':' '+n})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
